questions.prompt: Which of these capital cities are in Africa?
questions.fact: Dakar, the capital of Senegal, stands on the westernmost point of mainland Africa.

questions.prompt: Which of these characters did Shakespeare create?
questions.fact: Doctor Faustus is Christopher Marlowe's, Tartuffe is Molière's, and Beowulf is an Old English poem nobody knows the author of.

questions.prompt: How many days does a red blood cell live?
questions.fact: About 120 days. Your bone marrow makes around two million new ones every second to keep up.

questions.prompt: How far is it from London to New York in a straight line, in kilometres?
questions.fact: About 5,570 km, roughly seven hours on a plane heading west.

questions.prompt: Who created the detective Sherlock Holmes?
questions.hint: He was a doctor from Edinburgh.
questions.fact: Arthur Conan Doyle killed Holmes off in 1893 and had to bring him back ten years later because readers were furious.

questions.prompt: Which fruit is dried to make a prune?
questions.hint: It is small and purple, with a stone inside.
questions.fact: A dried grape is a raisin, sultana or currant, depending on the grape.
